name: Brandi AI
description: Brandi AI is an AI Visibility and GEO/AEO platform. This connector allows Brandi users to get in-depth insights from their Brandi AI instances.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Brandi AI to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Brandi AI to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://app.mybrandi.ai/api/llm/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Brandi AI MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Brandi AI provides these MCP tools: get_all_workspaces_and_brands, get_performance_summary, get_top_cited_domains, and get_top_cited_urls.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Brandi AI?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Brandi AI in data-analytics on the Manufact MCP catalog include Epicure, Newsflash, Point Topic, Pricing Optimizer AI, and StatCite.

_published_faq.name: Does Brandi AI MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Brandi AI requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Brandi AI is developed by Brandi AI, Inc.. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
